subject: Production gate: trial kickoff recap, blockers, and an ask for timing
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kumar <alex.kumar@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Production readiness: trial kickoff recap & next steps

Hi Alex / Sam —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our call and the smallest path to get a useful pilot running that will exercise production-like routing and telemetry. I pulled together a short checklist (attached) but the key items are below: 

- Network & access: VPC peering or secure tunnel, a service account with write to the sample bucket, and firewall rules for outbound to our control plane.
- Data: a 1–2 hour slice of the anonymized utterances (or a synthetic feed) so we can validate latency and tokenization.
- Telemetry: a temporary API key so we can send model-level metrics into your observability workspace for one week.
- Ops readiness: list of users who need console access + preferred SSO provider.

If we can close these four items we can get a warmed-up trial environment up and running in 48–72 hours and show a short demo of end-to-end latency, cost per token, and a couple of inference examples tailored to your clinical notes.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Pick a 30-minute setup slot this week for the infra handoff (I can join live and pair with your infra engineer).
2) Share the service account email and a sample data file (or confirm we should use synthetic).
3) Confirm whether you want streaming responses enabled (default: on) or prefer strict response chunks.

Attachment: trial-checklist.xlsx (live checklist + minimal commands)

Thanks — looking forward.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Redwood Inference — production-first inference for modern apps
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production readiness: trial kickoff recap & next steps

Quick internal note — Alex said they'd get the service account by EOD but I haven't seen anything come through. Security teams often block the VPC peering step; recommend we: 

- Send a short "priority check" follow-up that reduces friction (offer to run the peering call ourselves and provide the exact firewall lines).
- Offer a synthetic feed if data sharing is the holdup.
- If we still don't hear back by Friday, propose a "light bootcamp" session (30m + infra pairing) next week and include a cost estimate for dedicated capacity in case they want predictable latencies.

Draft (feel free to paste into your follow-up):
"Hi Alex — quick ping. If security is the blocker we can run the peering call on our side and provide sample firewall rules. If you'd prefer to avoid production data we can spin up a synthetic feed to validate latency this week. Do either of those help? Available: Thu 9–11am PT, Fri 2–4pm PT."

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kumar <alex.kumar@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Checking in — production gate for Redwood trial

Alex —

Wanted to follow up on the checklist I shared (attached again). Two quick ways we can keep momentum if security or data sharing is the current priority: 

1) We run the peering call and provide the exact firewall rules (we'll only need one infra engineer from your side for 15–20 minutes).
2) We spin up a synthetic stream that mirrors your traffic shape so you can validate latency and tokenization without any PHI leaving your network.

I also attached a screenshot of the test telemetry we capture so you know what you'll see in the console. If timing has shifted, totally understand — just let me know if we should pause outreach or continue to hold a 30-minute slot to do the bootcamp. Suggested times: Mon 9/27 10:00am PT, Tue 9/28 2:00pm PT, Thu 10/1 11:00am PT.

Links: setup checklist — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1TrialBootcamp
Attachment: sample-telemetry-screenshot.png

Thanks,
—Grace
From: Alex Kumar <alex.kumar@nimbushealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Rivera <sam.rivera@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Checking in — production gate for Redwood trial

Hi Grace —

Sorry for the radio silence, security just slammed our calendar with an audit and they're prioritizing internal infrastructure work through mid-October. Appreciate the options — spinning up a synthetic feed sounds like the easiest path to get meaningful telemetry without additional approvals. Can you: 

- Provide the commands / minimal config to run the synthetic feed on our side (we'll try first before scheduling the peering call).
- Also send a short note outlining an estimated monthly cost for the dedicated capacity option you mentioned (we're budgeting for October).

If you can send the synthetic instructions I can get an infra engineer to run them over the next week. Tentative: target to re-evaluate and move to a paired peering call the week of Oct 18.

Thanks —
Alex Kumar
Director of Platform Integrations
Nimbus Health
alex.kumar@nimbushealth.com
